name: 01-pragma-recursive-triggers
purpose: REPLACE deletes must not fire delete triggers; the guards assume recursive_triggers = 0

name: 10-seed-owner-events-commands
purpose: seed the owner, two turns and four owner commands (C0 is deliberately older than C1)

name: 11-seed-item
purpose: seed item M1 with a rules 'proposed' transition

name: 12-seed-topics-depth-01-32
purpose: chain A01..A32; every create runs the create-branch recursive CTE

name: 13-seed-topics-depth-33-64
purpose: chain A33..A64 (depth 64 is the maximum valid depth)

name: 14-seed-topics-branch
purpose: branch B02..B20 under A01 (a subtree 19 deep)

name: 15-seed-topics-merge-replay-placement-cursor-price
purpose: merge source D02 with children, replay tree F01/F02/F03 with three moves, a placement on D02, a cursor and a price

name: 19-check-seed
purpose: seed projected exactly once: 90 topics, 93 topic events, depth 64

name: 20-owner-transition-activate
purpose: valid owner activation through memory_valid_owner_commands (CASE in the WHEN clause evaluates remotely)

name: 21-check-owner-activate
purpose: owner activation projected once and is retrievable

name: 22-owner-transition-not-a-command
purpose: a conversation turn cannot authorize an owner transition

name: 23-owner-transition-stale-command
purpose: command C0 matches every operand but is older than the current transition's command

name: 24-owner-transition-fresh-command
purpose: control for 23: the identical row with the newer command C2 is accepted

name: 25-check-owner-superseded
purpose: exactly one accepted transition per command

name: 30-replace-cursor-rewind
purpose: H2: REPLACE on the natural key cannot rewind a cursor

name: 31-replace-price-natural-key
purpose: REPLACE with a new price_id on the (principal, model, effective_at) key

name: 32-replace-version-rowid-alias
purpose: REPLACE through the FTS content rowid alias (explicit rowid)

name: 33-replace-item-state-copy
purpose: REPLACE of a projection row by its own key

name: 34-replace-update-topic-key
purpose: UPDATE OR REPLACE cannot rewrite a topic key onto another topic

name: 35-replace-topic-event-copy
purpose: REPLACE of an appended topic event by its own id

name: 39-check-replace-unchanged
purpose: every rejected REPLACE left the rows untouched

name: 40-owner-topic-move-wrong-operand
purpose: command C3 authorizes parent A45, not A44 (operand binding)

name: 41-owner-topic-move-deep
purpose: valid owner move of the 19-deep branch under A45: ancestors 45 + subtree 19 = 64
triggers: memory_topic_events_insert_guard (move: ancestors + subtree CTEs, owner command), memory_topics_update_guard

name: 42-merge-deep
purpose: valid merge of D02 into A60: ancestors 60 + descendants 2 = 62; reparents two children and moves one placement
triggers: memory_topic_events_insert_guard (merge: ancestors + descendants CTEs), memory_topic_events_apply, memory_topic_aliases_insert_guard, memory_topics_update_guard, memory_item_placement_state_update_guard

name: 49-check-deep
purpose: deep move and merge each projected exactly once

name: 50-replay-stale-direct-update
purpose: re-projecting the older first move of F03 is refused

name: 51-replay-older-event
purpose: an otherwise valid move dated before F03's current event is refused by the insert guard (memory_topics_update_guard would also refuse it)

name: 60-cycle-move
purpose: F02 is now a child of F03, so moving F03 under F02 is a cycle (only the move CTE rejects it)

name: 61-cycle-merge
purpose: merging F01 into its own descendant F02 (only the merge CTE rejects it)

name: 62-depth-create-65
purpose: the create CTE caps depth at 64

name: 63-depth-move-over-64
purpose: ancestors 50 + subtree 19 = 69 (depth-sum clause only)

name: 64-depth-merge-over-64
purpose: ancestors 63 + descendants 2 = 65 (merge depth-sum clause only)

name: 69-check-topics-unchanged
purpose: no hostile topic probe changed anything

name: 70-clock-topic-future
purpose: topic event dated now + 10 minutes (strftime('now', '+5 minutes') bound)

name: 71-clock-topic-now
purpose: control for 70: the same rename dated now is accepted

name: 72-clock-run-now
purpose: run started now passes both strftime('now') bounds

name: 73-clock-run-past
purpose: run backdated 10 minutes

name: 74-clock-run-future
purpose: run started 10 minutes in the future

name: 79-check-clock
purpose: exactly one clock-bounded row of each kind was accepted

name: 80-s1-seed-unreferenced-price
purpose: S1 seed: a price no run references

name: 81-s1-replace-price-explicit-rowid
purpose: S1: REPLACE by explicit rowid deletes the guarded price row at 8b62e80; WITHOUT ROWID removes the column

name: 82-s1-check-price-survives
purpose: S1: Y4 must survive (at 8b62e80 it is gone, ok = 0)

name: 83-s2-seed-siblings
purpose: S2 seed: same-named topics under different parents

name: 84-s2-rename-onto-sibling-plain
purpose: S2: plain rename onto a sibling name fails on the unique index today, on the named guard after the fix

name: 85-s2-move-onto-sibling-replace
purpose: S2: REPLACE carried into the move apply deletes sibling G04 at 8b62e80

name: 86-s2-rename-onto-sibling-replace
purpose: S2: REPLACE carried into the rename apply deletes sibling G02 at 8b62e80

name: 87-s2-check-siblings-survive
purpose: S2: all four sibling topics must survive (at 8b62e80 two are deleted)

name: 88-s3-seed-owner-locked-items
purpose: S3 seed: three owner-activated items (M2 valid_to 2026-10-01, M4 valid_to already past)

name: 89-s3-rules-expire-future-dated
purpose: S3: rules expire an owner-confirmed fact early by future-dating occurred_at past valid_to

name: 90-s3-owner-transition-backdated
purpose: S3: transition dated before the current state's updated_at

name: 91-s3-rules-expire-now-plus-10
purpose: S3: rules expiry dated now + 10 minutes (new strftime('now') bound in the transition guard)

name: 92-s3-rules-expire-now
purpose: S3 control: rules expiry of M4 (valid_to past) dated now; at 8b62e80 it fails only because 91 already expired M4

name: 93-s4-ledger-reservation-now
purpose: S4 control: reservation dated now on run X1

name: 94-s4-ledger-reservation-future
purpose: S4: reservation dated now + 10 minutes lands in a later month bucket
